# Requirements Readiness Checklist: Ephemeral Stranger Meet Offers

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, consistency, and testability of `spec.md` as a pre-`/speckit-plan` product-owner approval gate (per the constitution's Spec Kit workflow, §6).
**Created**: 2026-09-10
**Feature**: [specs/spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the required data fields for a moving/transient meeting place (e.g., a queue or moving train) fully enumerated? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a default/configurable eligibility radius value defined for recipient matching? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the GPS sampling interval and "last known location" staleness threshold specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is fallback behavior defined for when push-notification permission is denied? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the rebroadcast flow fully specified, including whether it creates a new offer, what information is reused, and any rate/cap limits? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the verification states, checks, and incentives for optional photo/government-ID verification enumerated? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Are review turnaround time and enforcement actions defined for block/report moderation? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK008 Are ongoing/periodic re-verification and post-signup minor-detection requirements defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the v1 launch countries/regions documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Open Question 1]
- [ ] CHK010 Is a maximum length and edit/delete rule specified for an expression-of-interest text message? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the location source/freshness used to compute a displayed distance band specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK012 Is a free-text character limit and moderation turnaround defined for the meeting-expense note? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the rating follow-up prompt's timing/delay and rating scale specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the mapping from a registered-address city to an authoritative calendar/time zone defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK015 Are base (pre-discount) prices for weekly, monthly, and yearly subscriptions documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK016 Are trial/promotion rules, refund exceptions, and restore-purchase behavior defined for subscriptions? [Gap, Spec §FR-032, FR-034]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK017 Is "prioritize" (ranking offers near a recipient's current location) defined as a measurable ranking rule rather than a qualitative preference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the automated keyword/content screening rule set in FR-039 defined precisely enough to be implemented and tested? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK019 Is "approximate place/distance band" (shown before creator selection) quantified using the same band thresholds defined elsewhere in the spec? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, FR-026]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the measurement/alerting approach for the approximately-30-second push-delivery target specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Is "obvious violations" in the automated screening requirement quantified or otherwise made objectively testable? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-039]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK022 Do the capacity bounds in FR-008 (fixed at publish time) and the Key Entities "Selection" description (1-10) state identical limits without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the verification-badge behavior in FR-014 consistent with the badge-visibility rule recorded in Clarifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the block/report moderation-review requirements in FR-015 consistent with the immediate-own-view-update behavior recorded in Clarifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK025 Do the discovery-feed filter requirements in FR-022 match the filter list confirmed in Clarifications (activity, distance band, time remaining)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Clarifications]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK026 Can SC-008's "offer-to-interest conversion rate" be objectively measured without a documented baseline, target population, and measurement period? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK027 Is SC-017's "applicable local-currency prices" testable without documented base prices and a currency-conversion rule? [Measurability, Spec §SC-017, FR-036]
- [ ] CHK028 Are acceptance criteria defined for the automated content-screening false-positive/false-negative rate, given FR-039 is now the sole confirmed v1 safety net? [Gap, Spec §FR-039]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for what an interested recipient sees when the creator selects some, but not all, interested recipients? [Coverage, Gap, Open Question 6]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for the appeal flow when a mandatory government-ID upload is rejected or a minor-flag is disputed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Open Question 1]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for subscription lifecycle edge cases: failed renewal, refund, restore-purchase on another device, and plan changes? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-032, FR-034]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for what happens when an offer expires while a recipient is mid-submission of an expression of interest? [Coverage, Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements defined for connectivity loss during publication, notification delivery, expression of interest, selection, or chat creation? [Edge Case, Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for preventing a city-interest-only offer from being treated as "nearby" when a recipient's location is stale or unknown? [Edge Case, Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements defined for handling retaliatory, fabricated, or coercive public feedback following a meeting? [Edge Case, Gap, Edge Cases, FR-029]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK036 Are data-retention periods specified for location, chat, and moderation data? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK037 Are encryption, access-control, and audit requirements specified for government-ID, location, and payment-adjacent data, consistent with the constitution's data-protection rules? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption that a city label can be normalized and associated with both an offer place and each registered city interest validated against a defined normalization source? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the assumption that a user account/authentication mechanism exists validated, given the authentication approach itself is marked unresolved? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK040 Is there a documented rationale for FR-039's automation-only screening relative to the constitution's safety-first principle, beyond the product-owner confirmation now recorded in Clarifications? [Conflict, Spec §FR-039, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK041 Is a requirement and acceptance-criteria ID scheme (FR-###/SC-###) applied consistently across all sections referenced by this checklist? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
